description: kindred bond ECDH migration golden vector for @forgesworn/kindred. THE byte-exact cross-implementation contract: deriveBondSecret(myPriv, theirXOnlyPub) = SHA-256(x-coordinate of theirPub*myPriv), byte-for-byte identical to signet-protocol. A future Rust/WASM port and the signet-app migration both MUST reproduce `secret` exactly from these inputs (in BOTH directions — only the shared x-coordinate is hashed, so each seat lands on the same secret regardless of which y-parity it lifts). privA=11*32, privB=22*32; pubAXOnly/pubBXOnly are the x-only (BIP-340) pubkeys of privA/privB. Drift here breaks every migrated contact's verification words.
